answer.reason: The verses tell of Pul's coming against the land, the tribute paid to him, and the carrying away of the eastern tribes.

clauses.english: came against the land and was given a thousand talents of silver by Menahem
clauses.quote: Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver

clauses.english: was stirred up by God to carry the Reubenites, Gadites and half tribe of Manasseh away
clauses.quote: stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria

doubts: JER 50:17-18 speak only of 'the king of Assyria' without naming Pul, so they were left out.
1CH 5:26 names Pul and Tilgathpilneser together and says 'he carried them away'; it is not certain which king is meant.
